title: Late-Payment Fee on Professional Email Term Renewals
content:
Harborline's published flat late-payment fee on a Professional Email term renewal is read from the calendar days from the due date, the term end date, to the day the renewal is paid: 15 days or more carry 15.00 USD, from 4 up to 14 days carry 10.00 USD, from 1 up to 3 days carry 5.00 USD, and a renewal paid on or before its due date carries no late-payment fee. The late-payment fee is never reduced by any rate and is added to the rounded renewal component of the term renewal.

**Both sides of each threshold.**
- Paid on the due date: no fee. Paid 1 day after it: 5.00.
- 3 days after: 5.00. 4 days after: 10.00.
- 14 days after: 10.00. 15 days after: 15.00.

Example (hypothetical): a monthly term ending on 9 August whose renewal is paid on 15 August, 6 days late, carries a late-payment fee of 10.00.
